matters.title: Resolution - determining that Pumpout Stations provided by Keco Pump and Equipment are sole source items, and for related purposes.

attachments.name: Resolution - Approve Sole Source KECO Pump Out Stations 042126
attachments.text:
There came on for consideration at a duly constituted meeting of the Mayor and Members
of the City Council of the City of Gulfport, Mississippi, held on the _____ day of
____________, 2026, the following Resolution:
A RESOLUTION BY THE GULFPORT CITY COUNCIL TO DETERMINE THAT
PUMP-OUT STATIONS PROVIDED BY KECO PUMP AND EQUIPMENT ARE SOLE
SOURCE ITEMS, AND FOR RELATED PURPOSES
WHEREAS, the existing dockside sanitary pump-out stations at the Small Craft
Harbor/Marina are in need of replacement due to age, wear, and continued operational demands,
but the associated infrastructure (piping, mounting configurations, fittings, control interfaces, and
related system components) remains in satisfactory working condition and is not in need of
replacement; and
WHEREAS, the infrastructure (piping, mounting configurations, fittings, control
interfaces, and related system components) currently in place was designed to function
exclusively with sanitary pump out stations designed by KECO Pump and Equipment and
installation of pump out stations by a different manufacturer would require refitting of the
existing infrastructure; and
WHEREAS, the City desires to purchase the required replacement pump-out stations as
sole source items from KECO Pum and Equipment, and, pursuant to Miss. Code Ann. § 31-7-
13(m)(viii), the City’s Purchasing Agent, Jessica Versiga, has provided a Memorandum outlining
the reasons why these items may only be purchased from KECO Pump and Equipment (see
Exhibit “A” hereto); and
WHEREAS, for the reasons set forth in the Memorandum attached hereto as Exhibit
“A”, the Council finds that it is in the best interest of the City to declare the dockside pump-out
stations as described in Exhibit “A” hereto to be sole source items that can only be purchased
from KECO Pump and Equipment.
Page 1 of 3
NOW THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED BY THE MAYOR AND CITY
COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF GULFPORT, MISSISSIPPI, AS FOLLOWS, TO WIT:
SECTION 1. That the matters, facts and things recited in the Preamble hereto are hereby
adopted as the official findings of the Governing Authority.
SECTION 2. That the Gulfport City Council, consistent with fact, hereby determines
that, for the reasons set forth herein and in Exhibit “A” hereto, the pump out stations identified
more fully in Exhibit “A” are declared to be a sole source items that can only be purchased from
KECO Pump and Equipment.
SECTION 3. That this Resolution be, and it is hereby ordered to be spread on the
minutes of the Governing Authority, and to be in full force and effect immediately upon its
passage and enactment according to law.

introduced by ________________, seconded by ____________________, and was adopted by

attachments.name: Exhibit "A" to Resolution - Memo - Keco - Harbor - Sole Source
attachments.text:
Memorandum
To: Mayor and Members of the City Council
From: Jessica Versiga, Purchasing Agent
Date: April 2, 2026
Re: Sole Source – Keco – Municipal Harbor
The Gulfport Small Craft Harbor currently operates pumpout infrastructure that was
originally designed and installed to support KECO Marine Pumps. The existing system
includes the associated piping, connections, and supporting infrastructure necessary for
operation of the harbor’s marine sanitation pumpout service. At this time, the existing
infrastructure remains functional and serviceable, and only the dockside pump units
themselves require replacement due to age, wear, and continued operational demands.
After review of the Harbor’s existing system and operational requirements, it has been
determined that KECO pumpout stations are the only equipment that will provide direct
compatibility with the infrastructure currently in place without requiring significant
modification, reconstruction, or replacement of existing components. Procuring another
manufacturer’s pumpout system would likely require redesign or replacement of piping,
mounting configurations, fittings, control interfaces, and related system components,
resulting in additional cost, project delay, and potential service disruption to the Harbor.
In addition, the required replacement pumpout stations are only available directly from
KECO. KECO is the sole source manufacturer for these specific compatible replacement
units. As such, the product is not available through alternate manufacturers or equivalent
suppliers without requiring a different system configuration and associated infrastructure
modifications.
The procurement of KECO replacement pumpout stations is therefore justified on the
basis of compatibility with existing equipment and infrastructure and the need to maintain
continuity of service. This approach is in the best interest of the City because it:
• Preserves the value of the Harbor’s existing pumpout infrastructure;

• Avoids unnecessary demolition, reconstruction, or retrofitting costs;
• Minimizes downtime and disruption of pumpout services to harbor users;
• Ensures continued operational consistency, maintenance familiarity, and system
reliability; and
• Provides the most practical and cost-effective replacement solution for the
Harbor’s existing pumpout system.
Based on the above, the purchase of KECO pumpout stations for the Gulfport Small Craft
Harbor is recommended as a sole source procurement because the required replacement
units must be compatible with the existing installed infrastructure, and no other product is
known to meet this need without substantial modification to the Harbor’s current system.
Thank you for your consideration.

Memorandum outlining the reasons why these items may only be purchased from Universal Concepts
(see Exhibit “A” hereto); and
WHEREAS, the Council finds that it is in the best interest of the City to declare the youth octopi
as described in Exhibit “A” hereto to be sole source items that can only be purchased from Universal
Concepts.
NOW THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED BY THE MAYOR AND CITY COUNCIL OF
THE CITY OF GULFPORT, MISSISSIPPI, AS FOLLOWS, TO WIT:
Section 1. That the matters, facts and things recited in the Preamble hereto are hereby adopted as
the official findings of the Governing Authority.
Section 2. That the Gulfport City Council, consistent with fact, hereby determines that, for the
reasons set forth herein and in Exhibit “A” hereto, the youth octopi identified fully in Exhibit “A” are
declared to be a sole source items that can only be purchased from Universal Concepts.
Section 3. That this Resolution be, and it is hereby ordered to be spread on the minutes of the

attachments.name: Resolution - Approve Axon Body Worn Cameras 020624
attachments.text:
There came on for consideration at a duly constituted meeting of the Mayor and Members of the
City Council of the City of Gulfport, Mississippi, held on the _____ day of ____________, 2024, the
following Resolution:
A RESOLUTION BY THE GULFPORT CITY COUNCIL TO APPROVE AXON
ENTERPRISES, INC., AS A SOLE SOURCE VENDOR AND TO APPROVE AGREEMENT
WITH AXON ENTERPRISES, INC., FOR THE PURCHASE OF BODY WORN CAMERAS AND
FOR RELATED PURPOSES
WHEREAS, the City of Gulfport desires to replace the body worn cameras utilized by officers of
the Gulfport Police Department; and
WHEREAS, the Gulfport Police Department has requested to purchase the said body worn
cameras from Axon Enterprises, Inc., as a sole source vendor and, pursuant to Miss. Code Ann § 31-7-
13(m)(viii), the Police Department has filed a certification of the conditions and circumstances requiring
the purchase (See Exhibit “A”); and
WHEREAS, it has been confirmed that other cities in the State of Mississippi, including the city
of Oxford, have purchased Axon body worn cameras and supporting software using Axon as a sole source
vendor; and
WHEREAS, the Council finds that it is in the best interest of the City to award the contract for
body worn cameras to Axon Enterprises, Inc., and to approve a contract/agreement with Axon
Enterprises, Inc., concerning the same (see Exhibit “A” attached hereto).
NOW THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED BY THE MAYOR AND CITY COUNCIL OF
THE CITY OF GULFPORT, MISSISSIPPI, AS FOLLOWS, TO WIT:
Section 1. That the matters, facts and things recited in the Preamble hereto are hereby adopted as
the official findings of the Governing Authority.
Section 2. That the sole source designation of Axon Enterprises, LLC, requested by the Police
Department, the conditions and circumstances justify designating Axon Enterprises, Inc., as a sole source
vendor for the products and services required by the Police Department for the use of body worn cameras
are hereby approved, and that Axon Enterprises, Inc., is hereby declared to be a sole source vendor for the
said products and services and that the contracts/agreement with Axon Enterprises, Inc., and attached
hereto as Exhibit “A” be and the same are hereby approved, to the extent they comply with Mississippi
law, and are found to be in the best interest of the City, and the Mayor is hereby authorized to execute the
same on behalf of the City of Gulfport after final approval by the Legal Department.
Section 3. That this Resolution be, and it is hereby ordered to be spread on the minutes of the
governing Authority, and to be in full force and effect immediately upon its passage and enactment
according to law.

Clerk, was introduced by ________________, seconded by ____________________, and was adopted by
